title: vaccaria segetalis var. grandiflora
intro: Vaccaria segetalis var. grandiflora, commonly known as cow cockle, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its health benefits, such as aiding in the treatment of inflammation, fever, and cough. The therapeutic actions of Vaccaria segetalis var. grandiflora include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
